title: ConversationHistoryToSlack
description: The query parameters of the Slack Web API call conversations.history (a GET), exactly as sent, written as an object of strings: one page of messages newer than oldest. Later pages repeat the first page's parameters and add the previous page's next_cursor as cursor. The bot token goes in the Authorization header.

oldest.description: Only messages after this Slack timestamp.

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor; left out for the first page.
